text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both advancing strongly, with Ethereum's 10.9% surge outpacing Bitcoin's 6.2% gain—a sign that risk appetite is extending beyond the largest asset. The Fear & Greed Index at 62 (Greed) and up 33 points week-over-week reflects a marked shift toward optimism, while Bitcoin dominance holding steady near 59% suggests the rally is broad-based rather than concentrated in altcoins. Volume at $146B indicates solid participation, though not extreme, meaning the move has real momentum without appearing frothy.
